name: lookup_c6_w32_40and
detail: BDD path sum reached the normal form for all inputs and outcomes (40 measurements, 120 H, 80 HH, 0 omega; 19405 BDD nodes)
reference_how: copied from the development project; the reference IS the specification (table as multi-controlled X)
wires: a0..a5 address, z0..z31 target, h0..h5 clean work wires
note: z ^= T[a], address 6 bits, word 32 bits, 40 AND (2^c-c-1 = 57 for the standard lookup); random table (seed 1). Priority for the idea of a narrow lookup + adder in the GE framework: Luongo et al. 2025 (arXiv:2502.17325).
